title: Notification No.8/2025 Concerning the local food production recommendation certificate
text: Department of Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health issued Notification No. (8/2024) on 6 June 2025. This notification provides for the requirements that businesses applying for local food production recommendation certificate.
